mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 80 degree temperatures and clear skies near the high school, and if you look up tonight at 9:33 PM, the space station will soar from the northwest over Middleton toward the east near Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

If you need to stay informed, VHAT is your channel for local government meetings and community content. Also, remember to keep your recreational vehicles and trailers parked in designated spots at least five feet from your property line.

There is plenty to do this week, including Hop Haus Trivia on July 21 and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July 22 at Hometown Junction Park. You can also catch live music at Paddy Mac's on July 22 or head to Century School Park for the free Concerts in the Park series on July 23.
In our weekly report, on July 15, officers were called to a home on Prairie Oaks Drive where a 30-year-old man was arrested for felony bail jumping.
You can satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist. Head over to Culver's before they lock the doors at 10 PM, or stop by tomorrow for a refreshing scoop of Mint Explosion.
